title: Cusco: colonial painting on Inca walls
goal: Describe colonial Cusco and its school of painting, showing your attitude with stance adverbs.

items: I can show my attitude to a fact with stance adverbs (*lamentablemente*, *en rigor*, *precisamente*, *apenas*).
I can say what the Cusco School of painting was and what it mixed.
I can use the new words for art: *pintor*, *cuadro*, *catedral*, *gremio*.
